ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity contiguous blob extending from the peduncle to the median notch; two lateral high-intensity (white) regions on the lobes containing irregular low-intensity stippling and linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 75-degree V-shaped depression with a clear vertex dividing the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge with peak amplitudes ranging from 3-12 pixels relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the leading edges of both lobes tapering to acute-angled tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark stippled pixel clusters localized primarily on the lower half and margins of the white pigment on both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of dark, parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the high-intensity region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily frayed and irregular trailing edge contour; multiple rake-mark abrasions on the left lobe surface.
